semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company specializes in non-stick and wear-resistant coatings, which are not core semiconductor products.
summary: FUSSO KOREA CO., LTD. develops advanced coating solutions, including ultra-thin hard chrome plating and specialized non-stick coatings, primarily for manufacturing processes in various industries. Their products are designed to enhance surface properties and reduce wear, making them suitable for applications in semiconductor equipment and other manufacturing lines.
capabilities: Ultra-thin hard chrome plating with high non-stick properties
Tack Free series non-stick coatings for production lines
Room temperature coating technology for resin products
